requirements.md:234-241 (## Baseline Constraints, BL-001..BL-006) states compatibility (DS-29's step 3(a)/(b)/(c) and five field names unmodified), data-domain (Egress-Consent's three-valued domain frozen), security (the fallback's zero-upload and no-'consent'-substring invariants must survive, explicitly called out as the constraint round-1's own draft violated per the Critical finding at requirements.md:157), protected-file boundary (BL-004: no protected file touched), and migration (BL-005: workflow-state-registry.json entry; BL-006: AGENTS.md Active Spec Directories update) constraints explicitly and individually, each tied to the REQ/AC that enforces it.
